[Image: Two intersecting circles with centers A and B]

Two intersecting circles are shown. The smaller circle on the left has its center labeled A, and the larger circle on the right has its center labeled B. A vertical line segment connects P and Q, intersecting line segment AB. Line segment AP is drawn and labeled "7 cm", and line segment BP is drawn and labeled "10 cm".
